name: Candid Health vs Waystar
title: Candid Health vs Waystar: AI RCM & Eligibility Comparison 2026
description: Compare Candid Health and Waystar for revenue cycle management. See AI capabilities, pricing, eligibility features, and which is best for your healthcare organization.

summary.bottom_line: Candid Health is an AI-native RCM platform focused on claims autocorrection before submission - ideal for growing practices and telehealth companies. Waystar is an enterprise-grade RCM suite with industry-leading eligibility verification processing 90M+ transactions monthly - better for large health systems. Choose Candid for AI-first modern RCM, Waystar for enterprise scale and comprehensive payer connectivity.

key_differences.pricing_model: Candid (% of collections) vs Waystar (custom subscription)

sections.heading: Candid Health vs Waystar: Different Approaches to RCM
sections.content: Candid Health and Waystar represent different generations and approaches to revenue cycle management. Waystar, formed from the merger of Navicure and ZirMed in 2017, is an established enterprise RCM platform processing 90+ million eligibility transactions monthly with deep payer connectivity and comprehensive EHR integrations. Candid Health, founded in 2020 and backed by $219M from Andreessen Horowitz and General Catalyst, is an AI-native platform focused on claims autocorrection - proactively fixing errors before submission rather than managing denials after.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: The pricing models differ significantly. Candid Health uses percentage-of-collections pricing (typically 3-6%) with no upfront costs or implementation fees - they only earn when you collect. Waystar uses traditional subscription pricing that varies by organization size: $100-300/provider/month for small practices, $2,000-5,000+/month for mid-sized organizations, plus implementation costs of $2,000-10,000+. For growing practices wanting aligned incentives, Candid's model is attractive. For enterprises with predictable budgets, Waystar's subscription may be preferable.

sections.heading: AI Capabilities & Denial Prevention
sections.content: Candid Health's core differentiation is AI-powered claims autocorrection that learns from your claim patterns to identify coding errors, missing information, and payer-specific requirements before submission. This prevents denials rather than managing them after the fact, achieving 95-99% net collection rates and 50%+ denial reduction. Waystar's strength is in eligibility verification - proactively identifying coverage gaps and out-of-network risks in real-time. Both reduce denials but through different mechanisms: Candid through claim content, Waystar through eligibility verification.

sections.heading: Scale & Enterprise Features
sections.content: Waystar is better suited for large health systems with its deep Epic and Cerner integrations, HITRUST certification, and 90M+ monthly transaction volume demonstrating scale. Candid Health serves 200+ healthcare organizations and integrates well with modern EHRs like AdvancedMD, Elation, and Canvas Medical but has less enterprise EHR depth. For pure eligibility verification at scale, Waystar is the industry leader. For AI-first claims optimization, Candid is pioneering.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Consider your organization size and primary needs:

recommendations.when: You're a growing practice or telehealth company wanting AI-powered claims optimization with percentage-based pricing and no upfront costs
You're a large health system needing enterprise-grade eligibility verification with deep Epic/Cerner integration and HITRUST compliance
You're frustrated with high denial rates and want proactive AI that fixes claims before submission rather than managing denials after
Eligibility verification is your primary pain point and you need real-time verification across Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers at scale
You want aligned incentives where your RCM vendor only earns more when you collect more (percentage model)

faqs.q: What is Candid Health's claims autocorrection?
faqs.a: Candid Health uses AI to proactively identify and correct claim errors before submission - including coding errors, missing information, and payer-specific requirements. This prevents denials rather than managing them after the fact, achieving 95-99% net collection rates.

faqs.q: How many transactions does Waystar process?
faqs.a: Waystar processes over 90 million eligibility transactions monthly, making it one of the highest-volume eligibility verification platforms in healthcare. This scale demonstrates their payer connectivity and enterprise reliability.

Both prevent denials but through different mechanisms. Candid Health prevents denials through AI claims autocorrection (fixing claim content). Waystar prevents denials through eligibility verification (catching coverage issues). The best choice depends on whether your denials come from claim errors or eligibility issues.

faqs.q: How much does Candid Health cost?
faqs.a: Candid Health uses percentage-of-collections pricing, typically 3-6% depending on volume and complexity. There are no upfront costs or implementation fees. This aligns incentives - they only earn more when you collect more.
